# KalnyesGrowth

> Client Acquisition Systems for Local Businesses

KalnyesGrowth builds automated client acquisition systems for local service businesses. We combine custom websites with AI-powered tools that handle calls, texts, reviews, bookings, and follow-ups 24/7.

## Services

- **Custom Websites**: Professional websites built for local businesses with mobile-first design, SEO optimization, and conversion-focused layouts.
- **AI Voice Receptionist**: Answers calls 24/7, books appointments, and answers FAQs in the business owner's brand voice.
- **Missed-Call Text Back**: Automatically texts missed callers within 60 seconds so no lead is lost.
- **Reviews Automation**: Requests, monitors, and responds to Google reviews automatically.
- **AI Webchat**: Website chat widget that answers customer questions and captures leads.
- **Unified Messaging**: One inbox for SMS, email, Facebook, Instagram, Google, and webchat.
- **CRM**: Track every lead, customer, and conversation in one place.
- **Payments**: Send invoices and collect payments via text or email.
- **Appointment Reminders**: Automated SMS and email reminders to reduce no-shows.
- **Social Media Manager**: Schedule and publish posts across all platforms.
- **Email & SMS Campaigns**: Broadcast promotions, updates, and offers to your customer list.
- **Online Booking**: Let customers book appointments directly from your website or Google.
- **Customer Reactivation**: Re-engage past customers with automated win-back campaigns.
- **Google Visibility (SEO)**: Monthly SEO service to rank local businesses higher on Google Search and Maps.

## Pricing

### AI Systems (Monthly)
- Core: $1,497/mo (Website + AI Receptionist + Missed-Call Text Back + Reviews)
- Growth: $2,497/mo (Core + CRM + Payments + Reminders + Campaigns)
- Scale: $2,997/mo (Growth + Social Media + Reactivation + Priority Support)

### Individual AI Agents
- $497 to $1,297/mo each, depending on the agent

### SEO Plans (Monthly)
- Foundation: $497/mo (GBP optimization, on-page SEO, 30+ citations, monthly report)
- Growth: $897/mo (Foundation + 2 blog posts/mo, review strategy, competitor monitoring)
- Dominate: $1,297/mo (Growth + 4 blog posts/mo, backlinks, Google Ads management)
